hotels.title: Award-Winning Margaret River Luxury Villas with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Experience luxury in Western Australia’s Margaret River wine region, set alongside the pristine sands of secluded Bunker Bay. With direct beach access and breathtaking native landscapes across 35 acres, this is tranquillity unmatched. Indulge in an evening of culinary delights at Other Side of the Moon Restaurant, where local and Indigenous flavours that are perfectly paired with the region's acclaimed wines, and float away in the heated infinity pool. With its serene beachfront setting and pristine facilities - including two tennis courts, a fitness centre, complimentary Saturday yoga classes (advance booking required) and a world-class day spa - this resort is the perfect launchpad for adventures in the spectacular surrounds of the greater Margaret River region. Follow salt-licked walking trails to unearth Cape Naturaliste's majestic coastline, savour the region's gourmet food and wine at chef-hatted restaurants and cellar doors, and delve into the pristine landscapes of karri tree forests and magnificent caves.
